ln:4458590887.descriptionHtml:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Consultant Specialist.

 Business: Fin, Supervision and TR Tech

Job ID: 57388

Principal Responsibilities

  • Own CCR input data quality end-to-end: sourcing, preparation, mapping, enrichment, and validation for trades, collateral, agreements/netting sets, counterparty reference data, and market data.
  • Translate business outcomes into clear technical requirements (definitions, assumptions, acceptance criteria, control totals, and signoffs).
  • Design and run data controls: completeness, consistency, timeliness, reconciliation, and explainability of exposure movements.
  • Partner with stakeholders (Traded Risk, XVA/Finance, Front Office, Collateral, etc.) to resolve breaks, agree “source of truth”, and deliver at pace.
  • Drive modernization: support migration to microservices, Kafka/event-driven patterns, and improved observability (logs/metrics/traces), across GCP and on‑prem.
  • Support production stability: incident triage, root-cause analysis, runbooks, cut-off management (EOD/intraday), and controlled releases.
  • Work closely with developers and quants integrating Java/Python services with in-house C++ analytics libraries.
  • Identify and deliver AI use cases across CCR IT processes (e.g., data quality triage, automated breaks classification, exposure movement explanation drafts, control optimization), prioritizing those with clear risk reduction and efficiency gains.
  • Build and embed “AI-assisted operations” into BAU:
  • auto-summarization of incidents and change requests,
  • faster root-cause hypothesis generation using logs/metrics/traces,
  • automated runbook recommendations and knowledge-based upkeep.
  • Apply ML / statistical techniques for proactive controls such as anomaly detection on feed volumes, data drifts, reconciliation breaks, unexpected exposure movements, and limit breaches (with transparent thresholds and human override).
  • Enable safe, controlled GenAI usage for technical and non-technical outputs: requirements drafting, test-case generation, release notes, reconciliation commentary, stakeholder updates—ensuring correctness, auditability, and appropriate approvals.
  • Partner with engineering, data, and governance teams to ensure AI solutions are compliant and production-ready (model monitoring, change control, access controls, traceability, and clear ownership).
  • Measure value and outcomes: define KPIs (time-to-triage, break backlog, control failure rates, manual effort saved) and continuously improve solutions based on evidence.

Knowledge & Experience/Qualifications

  • Strong experience in risk/finance technology with a focus on data pipelines and controls (trade + reference + market data).
  • Good working knowledge of CCR fundamentals: exposure/PFE concepts, collateral & CSA terms, close-out netting, and how results aggregate (trade → netting set → counterparty/group).
  • Experience clarifying requirements with senior stakeholders and communicating clearly in writing (decisions, assumptions, impact).
  • Hands-on engineering ability in Java and/or Python, plus solid SQL and data analysis skills.
  • Production mindset: troubleshooting, incident management, and building observable and auditable systems.
  • Practical experience applying AI to workflows (not just theory): automation of repetitive analysis, operational processes, or decision-support in a controlled environment.
  • Strong Python for AI-enabled engineering: working with notebooks and/or services, prompt engineering basics, and integrating AI components via APIs into existing systems/processes.
  • Ability to validate AI outputs: establishing human-in-the-loop checks, quality gates, evaluation metrics, and clear audit trails so outputs are explainable and trustworthy.
  • Structured problem-solving mindset: can translate messy operational pain points into automatable steps (process mapping, control points, data requirements).

What additional skills will be good to have?

  • Experience with SA‑CCR implementation/support and/or CVA/XVA (including sensitivities).
  • Familiarity with Kafka, microservices patterns, schema versioning, and replay/idempotency.
  • Experience operating on GCP (and hybrid on‑prem/cloud setups).
  • Exposure to stress testing and regulatory reporting.
  • Experience with ML anomaly detection / time-series analysis for operational monitoring and data quality (e.g., drift, outlier detection, reconciliation break prediction).
  • Experience building internal tooling (e.g., workflow automation, ticket enrichment, knowledge search, runbook copilots) that improves team throughput.
  • Familiarity with model risk / AI governance concepts (e.g., monitoring, versioning, controlled rollout, documentation).

Job Board Tags

 /WX

/51

/LP

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Software Engineering.

Business: IWPB Technology

Principal Responsibilities

  • Manage complicated, cross platform production issues involving OS, Networking and Databases and on externally hosted platforms
  • Develop and manage robust CI/CD pipelines that implement DevSecOps principles as code.

  • Experience building and configuring monitoring/alerting (AppDynamics, Geneos, Datadog, Splunk, Datadog, AWS Cloudwatch)
  • Demonstrable experience of working closely with Product Owners preferably in the Equites, FX and Structured Products space.
  • 2+ years of software engineering experience in one or more of the following languages - Python, Java, C/C++, Ruby, and JavaScript

ln:4443909199.descriptionHtml:
HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening

up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Be responsible for successful implementation of Premier Acquisition strategies
  • Acquire new-to-bank customers via central or self-generated leads.
  • In order to deliver a high quality service to our highest value personal clients the role holder will need to complete simple retail sales.
  • Development of strong working relationships with relevant business areas (e.g., WPB, Marketing, etc)
  • Delivery high standard customer service to meet customer satisfactory

Qualifications - External

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • Minimum of one year proven and progressive financial services and/or retail sales experience or equivalent
  • Sound knowledge of various forms of deposits, WEM product, mortgage, etc.
  • Knowledge of the constantly changing laws/regulations governing banks/finance industry, consumer trends, competitor offerings, economic and foreign currency markets
  • Strong presentation and sales skills
  • Objection handling techniques and work under pressure
  • Good interpersonal and communication skills
  • Customer service orientation
  • Attain appropriate professional and regulatory qualifications as required by market
  • Attain any internal standards as required by HBCN

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

www.hsbc.com.cn/careers

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website. /FF

Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

The Reference Data Services Sr Manager accomplishes results through the management of professional team(s) and department(s). Integrates subject matter and industry expertise within a defined area. Contributes to standards around which others will operate. Requires in-depth understanding of how areas collectively integrate within the sub-function as well as coordinate and contribute to the objectives of the entire function. Requires basic commercial awareness. Developed communication and diplomacy skills are required in order to guide, influence and convince others, in particular colleagues in other areas and occasional external customers. Has responsibility for volume, quality, timeliness and delivery of end results of an area. May have responsibility for planning, budgeting and policy formulation within area of expertise. Involved in short-term planning resource planning. Full management responsibility of a team, which may include management of people, budget and planning, to include duties such as performance evaluation, compensation, hiring, disciplinary and terminations and may include budget approval.

Responsibilities

  • Manages complex and highly varying issues with significant potential impact on multiple operations' areas, with full management responsibility for one or more teams. Lead projects, resolves escalated operations' issues and/ or offer solutions at an advanced level.
  • Liaises with multiple Operations teams/departments.
  • Serves as analytical and/or procedural expert, representing a unit or team on cross functional processes or project deliverables.
  • Keeps abreast of the organization's operational procedures and best practices in business strategy and process/quality improvements; using such knowledge to recommend customized business solutions to internal clients.
  • Serves as subject matter expert in business, planning and analysis for operations area supported.
  • Acts as advisor or coach to new or lower level personnel on operational processes/procedures across multiple functions and/or departments.
  • Responsible managing overall resource management and allocation of work for assigned operations area for multiple teams/projects. Influences and negotiates with senior leaders (across functions); may communicate with external parties.
  • Directs team members in accomplishing their tasks to meet daily/weekly/monthly targets.
  • Demonstrates commitment to diversity, internal mobility and employee professional development.
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency, as well as effectively supervise the activity of others and create accountability with those who fail to maintain these standards.


Qualifications

  • Self-motivated with the ability to make decisions in the absence of detailed instructions and in a dynamic environment. Should demonstrate a commitment to quality and attention to detail.
  • Experience in complex project management
  • Excellent communication / negotiation / presentation skills
  • 15+ years experience in financial services; experience leading operational functions is required.


Education

  • Bachelor’s/University degree, Master’s degree preferred


Job Family Group

Operations - Services

Job Family

Reference Data Services

Time Type

Full time

Most Relevant Skills

Please see the requirements listed above.

Other Relevant Skills

For complementary skills, please see above and/or contact the recruiter.

Citi is an equal opportunity employer, and qualified candidates will receive consideration without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by law.

The KYC Operations Analyst 1 is an entry-level position responsible for participating in Anti-Money Laundering (AML) monitoring, governance, oversight and regulatory reporting activities in coordination with the Compliance and Control team. The overall objective of this role is to assist in the development and management of a dedicated internal KYC (Know Your Client) program at Citi.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with Relationship Management and Compliance teams to assist with the preparation, development, due diligence and approval of the electronic Know Your Client (KYC) record and supporting appendices
  • Create and maintain KYC records by obtaining information from internal and external sources (firm website, regulatory websites, etc.)
  • Partner with Relationship Management and Compliance teams to update system information from initiation to approval of KYC record and report workflow progress to supervisor
  • Validate the information within KYC records and Customer Identification Program (CIP) documents to ensure completion and accuracy
  • Ensure KYC records incorporate local regulatory requirements / Global Business Support Unit (BSU) Standards
  • Maintain BSU tool
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.


Qualifications

  • Previous relevant experience preferred
  • Minimum 3 years KYC/ Account Opening/ AML related working experiences


Education

  • Bachelor's degree/University degree or equivalent experience


Job Family Group

Operations - Services

Job Family

Business KYC

Time Type

Full time

Citi is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

About The Opportunity

Job Type: Permanent

Application Deadline: 30 November 2026

Title Senior Software Engineer II

Department FIL Dalian Systems

Location Dalian

Reports To Senior Manager

Level Grade 3

We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together - and supporting each other - all over the world. So, join our FIL Dalian Systems team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.

About Your Team

System department is to provide delivery and support services to internal systems.

About Your Role

The position is for an experienced senior Full Stack developer/specialist. The candidate will have deep expertise in backend development—particularly in Java, databases, and web service technologies—along with solid knowledge and hands‑on experience in application security, especially in API authentication.

The candidate should be able to implement complex business logic. As S/he may do development and deployment in the AWS environment, the AWS knowledge and experience would be a plus.

The successful candidate will deliver complex delivery tasks which would involve interaction with the business and system analysts for understanding the requirements followed by design, development and unit testing of the software. The candidate is expected to support global customers, so the English skill is required.

When required, the candidate will perform application performance tuning, identifying bottlenecks and implementing effective solutions.

The role may need support Fidelity Global partners such those in the Canada, UK, Indian, Hong Kong etc. based on business needs, the individual will need to work night shifts for 2-3 days per week (Shift working time from 1PM to 10 PM). An allowance will be provided on the shift day per company’s policy.

The candidate is expected to display professional ethics in his/her approach to work and exhibit a high level ownership within a demanding working environment.

About You

  • Extensive experience in Java/Web/API development.
  • Experience in Third party frameworks, Framework development experience, Oracle and SQL
  • Experience in workflow related technologies
  • Experience with AWS or other cloud systems
  • Experience software development to integrate with different backend systems
  • Experience in Tools that assist Development, Testing, Build and Source code Versioning.
  • Documentation skills and familiarity with project management methodologies.
  • API Integration Platform experience will be an added advantage.
  • Experience & good understanding of full development life cycle
  • Delivery and results focused.
  • Well presented with good communication skills.
  • Able to prioritise own activities, work under pressure.
  • Team player.
  • Business English is required.

One last point – if it goes without saying, it should not be included. This means things like ‘good communication skills’ and ‘basic computer competency’.

Feel rewarded

For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

The Group AI Platform team sits within CTO Platforms, part of HSBC’s Chief Technology Office (CTO). We build shared AI foundations that enable teams across the Bank to deliver AI solutions faster, more safely and at scale.

Our platform provides a “paved road” for AI delivery, bringing together seamless access to AI models and infrastructure, a consistent Agent HUB to build, deploy and manage production-ready AI agents, reusable AI capabilities (such as knowledge management and document intelligence), and built-in controls including guardrails, evaluation and monitoring to support responsible adoption.

We’re a global team with an established footprint across Asia (Hong Kong, Mainland China, India) and Europe (Poland, UK), and we continue to expand to support delivery across regions. Joining the team means working at the centre of HSBC’s AI enablement—partnering with multiple lines of business and functions across regions to turn AI capabilities into reliable, repeatable services that deliver measurable business value.Demonstrates an AI-native mindset, applying AI-driven approaches to improve productivity, quality, and decision-making.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Software Engineering (Group AI Platform SME)

Business:CTO Platforms (AI Platform)

Job ID：63664

 Location: Guangzhou/Xian

Principal Responsibilities

  • Own and deliver difficult engineering problems across core AI platform domains, including AI gateway capabilities, security guardrails, retrieval-augmented generation and agentic platform services.
  • Design and implement production-grade services in Go (Golang), with strong focus on concurrency, latency, throughput, fault tolerance and maintainability.
  • Make sound technical decisions in areas such as service boundaries, interface design, failure handling, observability, rollout safety and long-term operability.
  • Drive implementation quality through disciplined engineering practices, including code review, automated testing, performance validation, secure software design and clear technical documentation.
  • Convert loosely defined requirements or emerging platform needs into clear designs, delivery slices and durable technical solutions.
  • Work closely with principal engineers and peer engineers to challenge assumptions, refine designs and improve the overall quality of platform architecture and execution.
  • Contribute as a high-trust individual contributor who raises standards through technical depth, consistent delivery, practical mentoring and example-setting rather than formal line management.

Knowledge & Experience / Qualifications

  • Experience designing or operating gateway platforms, service control planes or application programming interface (API) mediation layers in complex enterprise environments.
  • Familiarity with security controls for AI systems, including policy enforcement, access control, auditability, model governance and runtime guardrails.
  • Practical understanding of retrieval-augmented generation architectures, including ingestion pipelines, embeddings, retrieval strategies, ranking and evaluation of answer quality.
  • Experience with agentic systems or platforms used to build, orchestrate and govern production-ready AI agents.
  • Working knowledge of Golang and/or Python for platform tooling, integration, experimentation or adjacent service development.
  • Experience with Kubernetes and cloud-native production systems, including deployment patterns, networking, scaling, resilience and operational troubleshooting.
  • Track record of improving engineering organisations through design reviews, technical standards, shared frameworks or uplift of peer engineering capability.

About HSBC Technology China

We develop, implement and support software and IT services and processes that allow HSBC to remain at the forefront of high-quality banking systems.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website. /51/LP/WX

Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.

Financial management

ln:4484909532.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

  • Oversee end-to-end banking regulatory reporting process including data collection and organization, understanding regulatory requirements, completing and submitting SCB China and branches regulatory reports. Ensure accurate, complete and on-time submission of all regulatory returns.
  • Support to identify and mitigate potential regulatory risks related to reporting errors, delays, or non-compliance, and implement corrective actions as needed.
  • Support to act as the key liaison with external regulators, providing updates, responding to queries, and representing the company in regulatory discussions and inspections.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, work closely with legal, finance, risk, and IT departments to ensure consistency and completeness of data used in regulatory submissions and to address any compliance-related issues.
  • Support to evaluate and improve the effectiveness of reporting systems and tools to enhance efficiency and reduce manual processes through automation

Key Responsibilities

  • Handle regulatory (NFRA, PBOC, SAFE, the Bureau of Finance, the Bureau of Statistics etc.) returns preparation and submission, ensures that all regulatory submissions are accurate, complete, and submitted on time, as well as regulatory reporting instruction changes interpretation and implementation.
  • Support line manager to maintain robust quality control procedures to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of all regulatory submissions, and reporting issues escalated through agreed governance channels.
  • Support PPG and China CA review and system upgrade project including end to end accounting flow review, upgrade the reporting logic, UAT support, regulatory reporting impact analysis to ensure compliance, accuracy and completeness.
  • Maintain good relationships with relevant internal departments, assist the line manager in coordinating with the finance department and other internal functional departments for discussions, such as establishing reporting procedures for new reporting requirements, and promptly and properly resolving related regulatory reporting issues.
  • Manage regulatory and internal stakeholder requirements, including preparation of management information, responses to regulatory enquiries, audit support, remediation plans and evidence of sustainable control improvements.
  • Support line manager to drive process and system optimisation improvements in processes, reporting, data quality through reporting automation while improving the transparency, efficiency and resilience of the control environment.

Skills And Experience

Must-have Skills

  • Solid knowledge of banking accounting and regulatory reporting rules
  • Hands-on experience in end-to-end regulatory reporting process
  • Strong data analysis and problem-solving abilities

Other Skills

  • High attention to detail and strict regulatory risk awareness
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Analytical and Communication skills
  • Strong accountability and ability to work under high pressure

Motivations

  • Operating in a complex and evolving China regulatory environment, very stringent regulatory environment casts great pressure on regulatory reporting including tight local reporting deadline, continuous changing reporting requirements, energized by the fast-paced, deadline-driven nature of regulatory reporting, motivated by the challenge of meeting tight deadlines under pressure while maintaining accuracy and compliance.
  • Motivated by the opportunity to streamline regulatory reporting processes, reduce errors, and enhance efficiency, driven by outcomes such as improved reporting accuracy, more efficient reporting process, reduced compliance risks etc.
  • Performs best in environments that encourage collaboration, knowledge sharing, and professional growth, motivated by working with cross-functional teams build a strong, capable regulatory reporting function.
  • Continuous learning and adaptability required, motivated by the need to stay current with regulatory changes, emerging technologies, and industry best practices, enjoy learning and applying new automation tools and methodologies to improve reporting systems and outcomes.
  • Driven by a commitment to ethical standards and accountability, motivated by the responsibility to uphold the organization’s reputation and ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

Qualifications

Key Experiences

  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively across different regulatory, cultural and organisational environments, adapting o global frameworks and local requirements while preserving appropriate governance, control and consistency
  • Proven Experience dealing complex issues through ambiguity, bringing together multiple stakeholders, forming a clear view from incomplete conflicting information and driving decisions and remediation through to sustainable closure

Certifications/Qualifications

  • CICPA & ACCA is preferred

Languages

  • Chinese and English

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Software Engineering (Productivity Suite).

Business:CTO Platforms (AI Platform)

Job ID：58138

Location: Guangzhou

Why join us?

HSBC Productivity Suite is our AI-powered workspace used by 250,000 colleagues across the bank. We’re moving beyond conversational generative AI to build intelligent agents and integrations that connect colleagues with trusted enterprise knowledge, services and workflows.

You’ll join a global engineering team solving complex problems at significant scale. You’ll have the opportunity to shape how artificial intelligence is designed, governed and used across HSBC, with real influence over architecture, engineering standards and product direction.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role for someone who wants to progress through engineering depth, delivery and influence.

The Opportunity

Our team consists of around 50 engineers across the UK, India, Poland and China. We’re continuing to grow our engineering capability in China and are looking for a senior engineer to provide technical leadership across one or more engineering pods.

As a Senior Associate Director, you’ll operate as a senior individual contributor on complex, high-impact engineering problems central to HSBC Productivity Suite. This is not a people-management role. It’s for an engineer who is strongest in hands-on system design and coding and wants to progress towards Principal Engineer through technical leadership rather than formal line management.

You’ll spend more than half your time designing, writing, testing and shipping production software. You’ll own significant AI capabilities and integrations, help define our technical vision and roadmap, and raise engineering standards across our global team.

Principal Responsibilities

  • Spend more than half your time on hands-on engineering, writing, reviewing, testing and shipping production code for HSBC Productivity Suite.
  • Design and build production-grade generative AI capabilities and integrations, taking ownership from initial design through deployment, operation and continuous improvement.
  • Provide technical leadership across engineering pods, forming a clear technical vision, setting direction and breaking complex programmes of work into manageable deliveries.
  • Make sound technical decisions across performance, security, cost, maintainability, technical debt, failure handling, observability, rollout safety and long-term operability.
  • Shape technical strategy and roadmaps, influencing priorities and translating user needs and ambiguous business problems into measurable outcomes and practical engineering plans.
  • Drive reusable capabilities, frameworks, engineering standards and effective technology controls, including monitoring and the safe use of AI coding tools and agents across the software development lifecycle.
  • Raise engineering capability through pairing, design and code reviews, practical mentoring, knowledge-sharing and example-setting, without formal line-management responsibility.
  • Lead continuous improvement in production stability, setting measurable goals to reduce incidents and recovery times and leading from the front during production issues.

Knowledge & Experience / Qualifications

  • Deep, hands-on software engineering experience, with a strong record of designing, coding and operating user-facing products and distributed services at scale.
  • Advanced use of AI coding tools, such as GitHub Copilot, to prototype, write, test and review code safely, alongside experience building agents that improve the software development lifecycle.
  • Strong Python expertise and practical knowledge of modern engineering practices, including application programming interfaces, microservices, databases, containers, automated testing and continuous integration and delivery.
  • Hands-on experience taking artificial intelligence, machine learning and generative AI solutions from experimentation through to secure, reliable production use.
  • Strong practical knowledge of large language models, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic workflows, evaluation, guardrails, observability and responsible AI.
  • Strong engineering judgement, with the ability to balance performance, security, cost, resilience, maintainability, technical debt and delivery pace when making complex design decisions.
  • Experience forming a technical vision, influencing business and engineering priorities, breaking complex work into manageable deliveries and raising standards through technical expertise rather than formal authority.
  • Strong ownership, problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to work autonomously across global and multicultural teams, explain technical trade-offs clearly and turn ambiguous problems into robust, measurable outcomes.

/51/LP/WX

About HSBC Technology China

We develop, implement and support software and IT services and processes that allow HSBC to remain at the forefront of high-quality banking systems.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for a motivated AI Engineering Intern to join the State Street Associates team. The candidate will work with experienced engineers to design, develop, and test end-to-end AI applications powered by Large Language Models (LLMs).

This is a hands-on engineering role for students who are passionate about AI and interested in turning emerging AI technologies into practical applications.

What You Will Be Responsible For

The candidate will be involved in:

  • Design and develop LLM-powered applications and AI agents using Python.
  • Work on key components of end-to-end AI solutions, including prompt engineering, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), agent workflows, tool integration, and APIs.
  • Explore and evaluate AI frameworks and technologies such as LangChain, LangGraph, vector databases, and LLM APIs.
  • Write clean, maintainable code and develop unit tests to ensure solution quality and reliability.
  • Participate in debugging, testing, and performance improvement of AI applications.
  • Collaborate with senior developers, QA engineers, and other team members throughout the software development lifecycle.
